placements.why: Both segments describe an e2e test suite's assertion and a probe memory built solely to carry that assertion for verification — this is squarely organizational proof/verification content, and no strata category exists yet in this repo to hold it, so the top-level category itself needs minting before the specific behavior it verifies can be placed beneath it.
placements.title: Automated tests stand as the org's mechanism for proving system guarantees
placements.frame: What guarantee is being verified, and what does the verifying artifact itself establish about the org's proof practice?

placements.title: Saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer
placements.frame: What accountability is created when a piece of content is saved, and how is that accountability guarantee enforced and verified over time?
placements.why: src-1 states a durable system behavior — saving a memory automatically confers reviewer status on its creator — which is a subject future envelopes about review/authorship mechanics can keep feeding, not a one-time fact; src-2 explicitly frames the whole probe memory as existing only to carry that same assertion, so both segments support one theme about this enrollment guarantee and its verification, nested under the newly minted Proof strata since the guarantee is evidenced here purely through an e2e test assertion.
